manual.description: Identification of the service manual, from its cover page

title.description: The manual's title as printed at the top of the cover, e.g. 'Service Instructions'

product_line.description: The model families and efficiency rating covered, e.g. 'APG/GPG 14 SEER'

product_description.description: What the equipment is, as printed under the product line, e.g. 'Gas Electric Package Units'

refrigerant.description: The refrigerant the equipment uses, e.g. 'R-410A'

publication_number.description: The manual's document or revision number printed on the cover, e.g. 'RS6300012r4'

publication_date.description: The month and year of this revision as printed on the cover

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer named in the copyright line

standards_compliance.description: The design standard(s) the unit is stated to comply with, e.g. 'ANSI Z21.47-CSA-2.3 Central Furnaces'

cooling_analysis_chart.description: The Cooling Analysis Chart: a troubleshooting matrix of possible causes (rows) against symptoms (columns), where a dot means the cause can produce that symptom

chart_title.description: The chart's title as printed, e.g. 'COOLING ANALYSIS CHART'

rows.description: One entry per possible-cause row, in the order printed, top to bottom

possible_cause.description: The possible cause in the leftmost column, e.g. 'Shortage of Refrigerant'

symptoms.description: The symptom column headers under which this row carries a dot, read from the rotated column labels, e.g. 'Low suction pressure'. Empty when the row has no dots.

test_method_remedy.description: The text in the Test Method / Remedy column for this row

service_procedure_ref.description: The reference in the See Service Procedure Ref. column, e.g. 'S-103'; null when the cell is blank

gas_heating_analysis_chart.description: The Gas Heating Analysis Chart, structured like the cooling chart

rows.description: One entry per possible-cause row, in the order printed

possible_cause.description: The possible cause in the leftmost column

symptoms.description: The symptom column headers under which this row carries a dot. Empty when the row has no dots.

test_method_remedy.description: The text in the Test Method / Remedy column

service_procedure_ref.description: The reference in the See Service Procedure Ref. column; null when blank

service_procedures.description: The servicing table of contents: one entry per numbered service procedure

page.description: The manual page number the procedure starts on

unit_supply_voltage_limits.description: Rows of the Unit Supply Voltage table

nominal_voltage.description: Nominal supply voltage as printed, e.g. '208/230'

max_voltage_imbalance_percent.description: The percentage of three-phase voltage imbalance above which the unit must not be operated
